description: Versioned advanced audit-policy profiles. Mask bits: success=1, failure=2. Omission and Not Configured preserve effective auditpol state; neither removes a GPO.

catalog.prerequisites: Command-line payload requires ProcessCreationIncludeCmdLine_Enabled. This profile only configures audit policy.
A matching AD object SACL is required. This profile does not create SACLs.
A matching AD object SACL is required. This profile does not create SACLs.
The CA AuditFilter must also select the events. This profile does not configure AuditFilter.
A matching file/folder SACL is required. This profile does not create SACLs.
A matching object SACL is required. This profile does not create SACLs.
A matching kernel-object SACL is required; enabling the subcategory alone does not generate object events.
A matching registry SACL is required. This profile does not create SACLs.

File System.note: Opt-in subcategory prerequisite only. Use configure-sacl separately for targeted file/registry SACLs.

Registry.note: Opt-in subcategory prerequisite only. Use configure-sacl separately for targeted file/registry SACLs.

Handle Manipulation.note: Opt-in subcategory prerequisite only. Use configure-sacl separately for targeted file/registry SACLs.

profiles.note: Shared replacement for the 34-policy configure list. Policies irrelevant to the selected role are not applied. The three targeted SACL prerequisites are opt-in.
